name: English
title: FeedTest
subtitle: Real sensor readings for feed and silage
help: Join the Wi-Fi network FeedTest. If your phone says there is no internet, choose to stay connected.
noSensors: No sensor is connected yet. Values will appear when hardware sends them.
voiceNoProblem: No problem was found in the measured values.
voiceLimited: The result is limited because some sensors are not measured.

voiceProblemAdvice.feedTemperatureHigh: Feed temperature is 5 degrees or more above air temperature.
voiceProblemAdvice.moistureHigh: Moisture is too high for this feed.
